# The inter-box cable (DB-25): build sheet

BUILD_GUIDE Part 4.8.3. **Male DB-25 at both ends** (both boards carry sockets), **shielded, all 25 conductors**, about 2 m. Solder-cup or IDC. The cable's **braid** is bonded to ground **at the power box end only**: soldered to the metal hood there (the hood meets power board J1's grounded shell); at the pod end, cut the braid back and insulate it, so it touches nothing (that hood still meets the pod's shell, which is fine: the braid is what must not form a loop).

Wire it pin to pin: pin N at one end to pin N at the other (a straight cable; no crossovers). Write each conductor's colour in the table as you go: it is the record a later fault-finder needs.

| Pin | Signal | Power board (box) | Pod board | Colour | Continuity | Not shorted to neighbours |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 5V_POD | +5 V through polyfuse F2 (500 mA) | into VIN_POD through D2 (diode-OR with USB's VBUS through D1) | | ☐ | ☐ |
| 2 | 5V_POD | +5 V through polyfuse F2 (500 mA) | into VIN_POD through D2 (diode-OR with USB's VBUS through D1) | | ☐ | ☐ |
| 3 | GND | ground | ground | | ☐ | ☐ |
| 4 | GND | ground | ground | | ☐ | ☐ |
| 5 | BRAKE_RPWM | 10 k pull-down (R50): off when not driven | driven by MCU pin 41 through 1k | | ☐ | ☐ |
| 6 | GND | ground | ground | | ☐ | ☐ |
| 7 | BRAKE_LPWM | 10 k pull-down (R51): off when not driven | driven by MCU pin 37 through 1k | | ☐ | ☐ |

| 12 | KILL_SENSE | E-stop second contact (J9), NC to ground | read on MCU pin 36; 10 k pull-up to 3.3 V; 1 k + 10 nF filter | | ☐ | ☐ |
| 13 | BOX_PRESENT | Q8 (2N7002) to ground while the box's 5 V is up | read on MCU pin 8; 10 k pull-up to 3.3 V; 1 k + 10 nF filter | | ☐ | ☐ |
| 14 | RELAY_LEFT | 10 k pull-down (R54): off when not driven | driven by MCU pin 26 through 1k | | ☐ | ☐ |
| 15 | RELAY_RIGHT | 10 k pull-down (R55): off when not driven | driven by MCU pin 27 through 1k | | ☐ | ☐ |
| 16 | RELAY_HAZARD | 10 k pull-down (R56): off when not driven | driven by MCU pin 9 through 1k | | ☐ | ☐ |

| 20 | CAN_TX | 10 k pull-up to 3.3 V (R59): recessive when not driven | driven by MCU pin 62 through 330 | | ☐ | ☐ |
| 21 | CAN_RX | SN65HVD230 (U4) R output | read on MCU pin 61; 10 k pull-up to 3.3 V | | ☐ | ☐ |

## Testing the finished cable (before it touches either board)

1. **Continuity, every pin:** meter on continuity between pin N at one end and pin N at the other,
   for all 25. Every one must beep. (Cheap "printer" cables often wire only some pins; Part 4.7.)
2. **No shorts:** with one end free, each pin against its neighbours in both rows and against the
   shell: open. Pins 3, 4, 6, 11 and 25 are all GND at the boards, but **in the bare cable they are
   separate conductors**: they must not beep to each other until a board joins them.
3. **Braid:** the hood at the power-box end beeps to the braid; the hood at the pod end does not
   beep to the braid (nor to any pin).
4. Tick the table, sign and date it, and photograph both ends before closing the hoods.

## Once both boards are up (power box powered, pod on USB)

| Pin | Check | Expect |
|---|---|---|
| 1, 2 | DC volts to GND at the pod's J7 | the box's 5 V less F2's drop: about 5.0 V |
| 13 | the pod's `SensorReport.ignitionOn` | 1 (BOX_PRESENT pulled low by Q8) |
| 12 | E-stop released / pressed | `killSwitchEngaged` 0 / 1 |
| 19 | brake pedal pressed (or 12 V on J10) | `obdBrakePedalActive` follows it |
| 10 | volts to GND at the pod, actuator idle | about 1.56 V (the ACS712's 2.5 V zero x0.667, loaded by the pod's 100 k): the firmware's zero-current reading |
